MDSE v2 Importer

One file. No install, no network. Reads a QEAX in your browser and works on a vault folder you choose.

1 · Source (QEAX)

No file chosen.

2 · Target vault

No folder chosen.

Add-onto mode never deletes. A note found by uid keeps your text, status and tags; only EA-owned keys, ## Source: EA and ## SysML v2 refresh. A changed type is reported, not written.

3 · Generate

A chosen folder with no vault in it (no .vault.yaml, no .obsidian) receives the base vault together with the notes. A folder that already holds a vault is only added to; nothing is deleted.
